title: Answer: a causally closed physical world, plus nonphysical mental properties

statements.text: What is fundamental is a physical world in which every physical event with a sufficient cause has a sufficient physical cause. In Jackson's version there are also nonphysical properties of experience, qualia, which are not part of the ontology of physical science and do no causal work.

sources.quote: whenever there is a sufficient cause of a physical event, there is a sufficient physical cause of that event
These works argue that consciousness involves properties above everything in the ontology of the physical science.
